data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: traveling
sections.question: traveling
sections.summary: the activity of going to different places, especially in other countries

senses.definition: the activity of going from one place to another, especially to different countries or regions, for pleasure or interest
examples: She loves traveling and has visited more than twenty countries around the world.
He saves money every month because he enjoys traveling to new destinations.

sections.title: watching movies
sections.question: watching movies
sections.summary: the activity of viewing films at a cinema or on a screen for entertainment

senses.definition: the activity of viewing films or movies as a form of entertainment, either at a cinema or on a screen at home
examples: She enjoys watching movies at home on Friday evenings with her family.
He loves watching movies and goes to the cinema almost every weekend.
